title: For Asean defense meetings, Lapu-Lapu City a no-fly zone

blocks.text: LAPU-LAPU CITY, Cebu — Flying drones, kites, balloons and other objects will be restricted across Lapu-Lapu City from Oct. 26 to 30, 2026 under security measures for the upcoming Association of Southeast Asian Nations (Asean) meetings. The city government declared its entire territorial jurisdiction a no-fly zone as it hosts the 20th Asean Defence Ministers’ Meeting (ADMM) and the 13th ADMM-Plus. In an advisory, the city government said the restrictions would be enforced under Ordinance No. 16-033-A-2022, in coordination with the Lapu-Lapu City Police Office (LCPO).
